in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew roots וויאול (viyul) meaning 'strength' and נטה (natah) meaning 'to bend', 'to submit' or 'to stretch'. This name is associated with a woman of great strength and power.

in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek roots βίος (bios) meaning 'life' and λανθάνω (lanthano) meaning 'to hide' or 'to escape', 'to conquer' or 'to vanquish'. This name is associated with a woman who triumphs over life and death.
